scope: Optional reviewed cross-lesson routes through representations, order parameters, exchange, conservation, layers, chirality, quantum geometry, phonon import and thermodynamics, equilibrium tensors, bulk and device transport, pairing and NS scattering, band representations, finite-wavevector ordering and SU(3) recoupling; schema-valid classroom drafts, explicit conventions, and the retained pinned official Phonopy example.
verification: All indexed routes and identities resolve; explicit prerequisite/next edges are acyclic, reasoned and optional. Same-name point-group and Lie lessons remain distinct.
The graph loads only for learning views. Local chapter changes update it without changing course-render behavior; stale async callbacks cannot expose a lab graph.

The original official band and companion structure files retain their exact SHA-256 and full BSD license. Real frequencies, q-point order, path segmentation, eigenvectors and selected mode flow through public calculation entries.
Length and frequency declarations preserve provenance, distinguish explicit user confirmation, and reject inconsistent units. Frozen-mode export converts declared au lattice lengths into Angstroms.
SPT entropy retains the original natural-log numeric field and adds nat/bit metadata and conversion. Density-matrix entropy retains its original log2/bit numeric field.

All four pathway families retain raw valid or incomplete drafts through actual course-tab handlers. Valid inputs do not produce a false schema warning; incomplete fields identify their own validation error. Ordinary tab navigation does not run a calculation.

Thirty-four additional optional connections come from substantive reading of 21 existing lessons, their exercises, declared models and bounded operation panels. All destinations resolve and the combined graph remains acyclic. Links retain polar/axial action spaces, energy-unit choices, finite layer-normal boundaries, and the distinct geometry and response refinement grids.

Forty-eight further optional connections preserve the preceding 82 and connect 47 previously index-only lessons. Every one of the 197 registered lesson panels renders its exact native prerequisite and next hrefs, including overflow links. The 130-edge graph remains acyclic, all visible reasons have English translations, and every newly connected lesson is exercised through the actual classroom shell without calculation or mastery-state access.

Visible reasons distinguish ordinary frequency and input-cell thermal normalization, tensor intrinsic symmetry and engineering shear, SI Boltzmann moments and device absorption, arbitrary pairing scales and NS eV, fractional and radian Bloch momentum, and GT copy gauges versus dimension-reduced 6j/9j tables. These are preparation recommendations, not automatic transfer of numeric results between different models.
limitations: 197 routes are a factual inventory, not a semantic review of all lessons. Only the 112 lessons connected by the 130 reviewed edges have those recommendations; other indexed lessons retain a directory fallback.

A reviewed learning connection identifies a concrete concept to carry between lessons. It does not certify a complete operation-level derivation, diagnostic remediation, or authentic-material workflow in either lesson.
These software and reference-calculation checks do not measure student learning or complete the broad site audit.

The official Al data are an existing monatomic calculated example with real and complex supplied eigenvectors, including relative complex phases. They are not experiment, newly computed data, optical-branch validation, or a general unequal-mass multi-atom import audit.
The band file has no frequency-unit declaration. The example entry explicitly selects THz; the selected convention is not relabeled as file metadata.
SPT pure-state subsystem entropy and mixed-state von Neumann entropy are not interchangeable entanglement measures.
